comments.body:
Recipe:

Quarters - Transformation
R15 Storage/Alchemy

Ingredients:

Ancient Aether Charm (Sml) x3
Axe Fragment x1
Mysterious Powder x1

Result: Ancient Aether Charm (Med)

It can be used in the following recipe accessed from Atlantis' Priest:

Recipe: Power Amplification

Alchemy r18
Storage r16

Ingredients:
Orichalcum x1
Ancient Aether Charm (Med) x4
Core of a Bronze Statue x1

Result: Ancient Aether Charm (Lrg)

Note: As with the Ancient Aether Charm (Sml) item, you can only use ONE of these at a time. It is possible to stack Mysterious Aether Charm with them.
